No dedicated CommandPalette component; POC uses Input + filtered clickable rows. Notifications need WindowExt and Notification::info.
rustc 1.97.1 satisfies gpui-component 1.90+ requirement. WezTerm docs still say 1.71.
cargo check in wezterm-gpui succeeded after isolating the workspace. First resolve pulled ~844 packages.
Putting rev= on gpui/gpui_platform while gpui-component uses unpinned zed git duplicates gpui (two Styled/Entity types). Pin gpui-component rev in Cargo.toml; pin Zed via Cargo.lock.
wezterm-gpui.exe opened an HWND titled WezTerm GPUI - Command Palette (MainWindowHandle non-zero). D3D11/GPUI event loop works on this Windows host.

cargo build -p wezterm and cargo build --manifest-path wezterm-gpui/Cargo.toml. wezterm gpui --hello → child wezterm-gpui.exe, HWND WezTerm GPUI - Hello. wezterm gpui → same binary, HWND WezTerm GPUI - Command Palette. Binary resolved to wezterm-gpui/target/debug/wezterm-gpui.exe from wezterm.exe current_exe relative path. Default wezterm-gui not started. Windows GetWindowText shows ASCII hyphen even though source title uses an em dash.

Minimum usable GUI for this POC is chrome (tabs, title bar, palette overlay), not a working shell. Terminal cells and PTY remain in wezterm-gui. Default binary window changed from standalone palette to AppShell.

User launched target\debug\wezterm.exe gpui, used the palette (Copy to clipboard, Split pane horizontally — notify-only commands), and said the app shell looks good. Those two commands do not mutate chrome; New Tab / font size / quit do.

gpui-component Root stores the open_dialog/open_alert_dialog builder as Fn and re-runs it each render. Callbacks and titles must be Clone (Rc for on_ok). Dialog does not auto-build a footer from button_props; AlertDialog.build_surface does. Prompt footer uses DialogFooter + DialogClose + DialogAction.

wezterm-gpui path-deps portable-pty and wezterm-term. Isolated workspace still compiles; wezterm-term inherits root workspace.dependencies by walking up. Did not pull wezterm-font/freetype. mux skipped (config/lua). Screen::visible_lines is cfg(test) only; POC uses for_each_phys_line sliding window of physical_rows.
